briefdescription.para: Helper: attempt to acquire m within deadline; returns true on success.
Phase C prerequisite gate — thread-safety, lock-ordering, and consensus coordination robustness focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para:
Test tracks:
TSO-01..TSO-08 Thread-safety correctness (concurrent read/write on shared structures in ReplicaConsistencyManager and DualConsensusOrchestrator stubs)
LKO-01..LKO-06 Lock-ordering correctness (no deadlock under concurrent acquisition; hierarchy state(1)<audit(2)<metrics(3) and state(1)<callbacks(2)<cluster(3)<snapshot(4))
CCR-01..CCR-06 Consensus coordination robustness (timeout detection, quorum-loss detection, retry on transient failure)
All infrastructure is fully in-process with deterministic stubs. Seed: kShardTSOSeed = 42.
